title: engines.agent_dispatched
description: T7:engines agent_dispatched payload. Written by the HARNESS (cwos-dispatch-ledger.js record, a PostToolUse hook on the Agent tool), never by the model: requested_model is what the orchestrator asked for (tool_input.model alias, null = inherited), resolved_model is what Claude Code says actually ran (tool_response.resolvedModel). Closes the recording half of WS-476: the 2026-10-10 fleet probe found 0 of 29 engine runs naming a model when recording was left to prose.

work_items.description: WS-NNN ids named in the dispatch description or prompt (WS-1170) — lets report --by-item compare each item's lane model with what was requested and what ran
